title: RUN FOR FREEDOM Bitcoin Thailand Half Marathon 2026 Review: Chiang Mai's Crypto-Themed Race
seo_title: Bitcoin Thailand Half Marathon 2026 Review | Chiang Mai Race
meta_description: RUN FOR FREEDOM – Bitcoin Thailand Half Marathon 2026: November 22 at Rot Fai Park, Chiang Mai. 21K/10K/5K from Jog & Joy with registration open — the world's most unusual race theme reviewed.
dek: Set for 22 November 2026 at Rot Fai Park in Chiang Mai, this Jog & Joy-organised half marathon carries perhaps the most distinctive race theme in Asia: Bitcoin. Registration open, three distances, and a Chiang Mai cool-season date.
verdict: RUN FOR FREEDOM – Bitcoin Thailand Half Marathon is genuinely one of the most unusual branded races in Southeast Asia: a Bitcoin-themed half marathon organised by Jog & Joy, one of northern Thailand's most established race producers, at Chiang Mai's Rot Fai Park. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. The crypto theme aside, the fundamentals are solid: a proven organiser, a cool-season November date in Chiang Mai, and a flat, fast park-based course. Suits runners who want a well-organised Chiang Mai half with a conversation-starter theme.

sections.heading: The Theme: Bitcoin Meets Running
paragraphs: The RUN FOR FREEDOM branding and Bitcoin theme make this arguably the most distinctive race concept in Thailand. [1] Jog & Joy — the team behind the Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon — brings serious production values to the novelty theme, meaning the race-day experience should be professionally run regardless of the crypto wrapper.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want a well-produced Chiang Mai half marathon with a genuinely unique theme, cool November conditions, and open registration, this is worth booking. 22 November 2026 at Rot Fai Park, Chiang Mai. [1]
